tiebreakers.description: Official rulebook gives no tiebreaker; most Glory wins.

notes: family: area-majority (Glory race + area STR quests/battles). Glory is earned during play via battles, quests, Ragnarok deaths (2/3/4 per figure by Age), pillage, cards; only the clan-stat bonus is added at the end. A stat at the last step earns +20 (not +10 + 20). Base game; expansions/gods not modelled.
